propositions: Optional configuration key enforce_plan_material_pins enables fail-closed invalidation of attestations with malformed, missing, or stale plan-material pins.

Derived health contract aggregates pin status (current, stale-pin-drift, stale-pin-missing, malformed-pin, legacy-unpinned) per target with per-target detail (canonical_id, role, pinned_fingerprint, current_fingerprint).
compute_validity extended with PlanValidityProfile (DEFAULT, CLOSE, DRIFT_REFRESH) to selectively disable code-freshness checks while preserving signature, registry, own-material, and pin validity.

drift_refresh_candidate delegates all validity checks including pin enforcement to compute_validity(DRIFT_REFRESH) and returns None if invalid, retaining only dependency-hash drift qualification inline.

resign_plan_review reads reviewed_related_material from sidecar and invokes derive_plan_material_pin_health to block re-sign on pin invalidity when enforcement enabled, without calling compute_validity.
Full LLM review emits reviewed_related_material from pre-LLM snapshot as optional sidecar field; re-sign recovery uses this to diagnose pin state without requiring a certified attestation.
